guards.expected: Public conservative optimized cap128 exceeded: AFTER uses identical perrow native fallback, correct output and canaries. Cap128 is study dispatch policy, NOT claimed hardware max.
Host reject nonrepresentable/non32byte UB pitch before device/fixture cache. Two actual prepare/interface checks, no numerical oracle or captures.

contract.interface: Immutable contiguous FP32 x[rows,columns] bounded[-1,1], y=x+1 FP32 same shape/nonalias. Positive rows/columns, columns<=128, local rows*ceil(columns/8)*8*4 <=65536 bytes. Public optimized rows<=128 else safe perrow fallback within bounded local scope; other invalid extents hostreject. These conservative software bounds are not hardware field maxima.
contract.physical_layout: UB pitch exactly ceil(columns/8)*8 elements. Only zero sourceStride bytes and zero destinationStride 32-byte blocks in aggregated command; blockLen=columns*4 bytes, blockCount=rows. Audit actual selected SDK declarations and native byte/block semantics. No guessed field overflow or underflow. Initialize UB padding identically both sides; padParams(false) alone does not prove zeros.
contract.before: One native DataCopyPad GM→UB command per row at unchanged UB pitch; same tiny Adds(+1) consumer and identical copyout policy as AFTER.
contract.after: Replace only repeated row input copy commands with one DataCopyPad blockCount=rows command. Same row batch, grid, UB storage, padding, bytes, arithmetic, synchronization and copyout. All preparation and padding initialization inside fullAPI. Prefer one AIV block/kernel, native dependency barriers correct.
contract.synchronization: Explicit correct producer/consumer order among padding fill(V), input transfer(MTE2), consumer(V), copyout(MTE3). Hold all barriers/events identical between arms except DMA command encoding; do not overlap zero initialization with live input or elide reuse hazards.
contract.oracle: Independent CPU FP64 x+1 rounded to FP32; exact bitwise equality. Inspect input immutability/output nonalias/prefix and suffix GM canaries in once-only correctness. No profile IO inspection or extra mainforward.
contract.profiling: Source expected row-command count rows vs1 is not a measured PMU count. Preserve supported scalar/MTE/vector raw fields and actual code/resources. No physical bandwidth/roofline from pipe ratios. Same single kernel botharms; compile-noop/no timing benefit retained honestly.
